external_entities.name: supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the portal and pushes a nightly supplier data extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: supplier master service
processes.description: Loads the nightly supplier data extract from the landing bucket and writes the records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor's platform where supplier compliance documents remain stored.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organization's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract before it is picked up by the supplier master service.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Supplier uploads compliance paperwork to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category manager reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it in the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection status.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service picks up the nightly extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file
data_flows.data_description: Nightly supplier data extract in CSV format.

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: Vendor pushes the nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says the nightly extract is encrypted end to end, while the landing-bucket runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is. Encryption in transit is therefore unknown.
data_flows.data_description: Nightly supplier data extract in CSV format.

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes the extracted supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

trust_boundaries.name: vendor platform
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-controlled hosting zone containing the supplier document portal and stored compliance documents.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud-account zone containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source calls it a portal; a portal is modeled as a web application interface.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform stores confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The platform stores compliance documents and contact details for suppliers' staff, including personal data.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket stores confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The bucket receives a supplier data extract derived from supplier records that include staff contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database stores confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The database stores supplier records derived from data that includes contact details for suppliers' staff.
